description: Mike Harding, Doris Bry, Tish Frank, Georgia O'Keeffe, Quida Ball and others walking into canyon. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe and Others Walking into Canyon
